name: Tender Compliance Matrix & Response Skeleton
description: Two-corpus compilation: extracts every requirement from tender documents (fact_type='requirement', one row each, clause-cited), then maps the company's own material (past project docs, certificates, CVs, procedures) against each requirement — coverage where evidence exists, blocking gaps where it does not. Uses grammar v2 repeat_for to instantiate one response block per requirement. This is the requirements traceability matrix EPC teams build by hand over weeks.

sections.title: Requirements Register
sections.notes: One row per 'shall/must/skal' in the tender: req ID | requirement (near-verbatim) | type (mandatory/evaluated/info) | tender clause. Modal precision preserved. Checkpoint: user confirms the register BEFORE mapping runs (outline gate pattern) — a missed requirement here is a disqualified bid, so this list is the product.

sections.title: Compliance Matrix
sections.notes: GRAMMAR V2: one instance per confirmed requirement. Engine maps the company corpus (linked folders: past projects, certs, CVs, procedures) against each: status Dekket (evidence cited: which document, what it shows) / Delvis / GAP. Every 'Dekket' cites company-source facts; the engine NEVER asserts compliance without evidence — an unmapped mandatory requirement is a blocking gap, which is exactly the point: know your gaps three weeks before the deadline, not three days.

sections.title: Response Skeleton
sections.notes: Per requirement: a factual response paragraph compiled from cited company evidence + an author_placeholder '[AUTHOR: win theme / differentiation]'. The engine assembles proof; the bid team writes the persuasion. Same honesty split as the thesis discussion chapter.

sections.title: Commercial & Delivery Flags
sections.notes: Extraction-only: LD rates, bond requirements, unusual payment terms, missing caps — each 'found in clause X' or 'not found in provided documents'. What it means commercially is the bid manager's call.

sections.title: Source Register (Tender + Company Corpus)
sections.notes: Both corpora listed separately. Referenced-but-missing tender appendices surface here.

sections.title: Declaration
sections.boilerplate: This matrix was compiled by extraction from the tender documents and mapping against the company material listed in the Source Register; every requirement and every claimed coverage is traceable to cited sources. Completeness of the requirements register must be verified by the bid team. This document records findings; it is not legal or commercial advice.
sections.boilerplate_no: Denne matrisen er sammenstilt ved uttrekk fra anbudsdokumentene og kartlegging mot eget materiale oppført i kilderegisteret; hvert krav og hver angitt dekning er sporbar til siterte kilder. Kravregisterets fullstendighet må verifiseres av tilbudsteamet. Dokumentet gjengir funn; det er ikke juridisk eller kommersiell rådgivning.
